lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear grid arrangement consisting of approximately five horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a coordinate-like grid across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge on the upper flank characterized by a high-contrast transition from a light dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 10-12 high-luminance spots contained within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a remora (Echeneidae) attached to the ventral-lateral region posterior to the pectoral fin.
